title: The Klein LoRA rack: stop a cross-tier LoRA binding nothing, move the cogwheel to the run stage, and GC the pre-rename weights
description: Umbrella over MPI-614 (cross-tier LoRA binds NOTHING and the run still reports success), MPI-613 (the LoRA cogwheel belongs on the flow RUN stage), and MPI-612 (garbage collect the pre-rename Klein style LoRAs). All three are the Klein style-LoRA rack seen from three sides: correctness, iteration loop, and cleanup. Phases run in that order; phase 3 is release-gated and cannot start until the release carrying MPI-609 is two-three releases old.
